parts.text: "Deliver one self-contained index.html (Three.js via CDN allowed, no other external assets). It must run when opened and start an automatic demo or attract mode without any user input. Build a 3D voxel Japanese garden in Three.js: a pagoda, cherry blossom trees, a koi pond with koi swimming on curved paths, and falling petal particles. Add a day/night cycle with a time slider and lighting that changes smoothly. The camera slowly orbits by default, and the user can drag to orbit."
Attract-mode voxel garden with pagoda, koi, and day/night cycle — drafting your build plan.
Designing a single-file ThreeJS CDN architecture with voxel rendering, auto demo, day-night cycle, and camera controls while balancing performance and asset constraints.
Choosing ES modules with importmap over UMD and custom orbit controls to ensure file:// compatibility and reduce CDN dependencies.

## Plan: 3D Voxel Japanese Garden — single `index.html`

**Goal:** One self-contained `index.html` (Three.js CDN only) that runs on double-click/`file://` with no input, showing auto-orbiting voxel garden.

### 1. Delivery constraint decisions
- **Three.js via CDN, no build step:** Use ES modules + `importmap` pinned to a version, e.g. `three@0.160.0` from `unpkg` or `jsdelivr` with fallback. No `OrbitControls` import — implement ~30-line custom drag-orbit to avoid second CDN dependency and `file://` CORS issues.
- **No other external assets:** All geometry is `BoxGeometry` voxels; all textures procedural (vertex colors / canvas-generated sprite for petals if needed). No fonts, HDRs, or images.
- **Must auto-start:** No click-to-start. `requestAnimationFrame` loop starts on `load`, auto-orbit + auto day-cycle + koi + petals all running by default.

### 2. File structure (single file)
```
index.html
  <style> — fullscreen canvas, overlay UI (title, time slider, day/night readout, pause/play)
  <script type="importmap"> — three CDN mapping
  <script type="module">
    1. Imports, renderer/scene/camera/fog setup, shadows on
    2. Lighting rig: sun DirectionalLight + HemisphereLight + ambient + lantern PointLights + moon
    3. Voxel helpers: `addVoxel(x,y,z,color,size)`, shared BoxGeometry + materials cache, InstancedMesh for grass/trees/petals
    4. Garden builders: base island, pond basin + water, pagoda(), cherryTree(), stone lanterns, bridge/fence/rocks
    5. Koi system: N=8-12 voxel fish, each on curved path `pos(t)` in pond ellipse
    6. Petal particle system: InstancedMesh ~300 quads falling + sway + recycle
    7. Day/night cycle: `timeOfDay 0-24`, sky/sun/fog/lantern lerp, UI slider two-way bound
    8. Camera: auto-orbit + pointer drag + wheel zoom + touch
    9. Resize + animate loop with delta clamp
```

### 3. Scene contents
- **Base:** 32×32 voxel grass island on stone plinth, stone path voxels, fence posts.
- **Pagoda (center-back):** 3 tiers: red pillars + cream walls + dark grey overhanging roofs (stepped voxels for slope), top spire `sorin` stack. Windows emissive at night.
- **Cherry trees (×3-4):** Brown trunk column with branches, pink canopy = ~80-150 jittered voxels in blob, 2-3 pink shades.
- **Koi pond (front):** Recessed blue basin, semi-transparent animated water plane (opacity + slight y bob / moving normals via vertex offset), stone rim. Koi: body 3-4 voxels (white/orange/black variants) + tail voxel wagging by `sin(t)`, oriented along path tangent.
- **Extras for depth:** Stone lanterns with warm `PointLight` (only intense at night), arched bridge or stepping stones, rocks, low shrubs.
- **Sky:** `scene.background` color lerp + fog lerp; sun sphere + moon sphere on circular arc; stars (`Points`, visible at night via opacity).

### 4. Day/night + lighting (smooth)
- State: `timeOfDay` float, `autoCycle=true`, speed ~24h in ~90s.
- UI: range slider `0-24 step 0.1` + label (e.g. `18.5 — Dusk`) + pause/play button.
- Per-frame: sun angle = `(time-6)/12*PI`; `sun.position` on arc; `DirectionalLight` color/intensity lerp (warm dawn → white noon → orange dusk → dim blue night); `HemisphereLight` sky/ground lerp; lantern lights + window emissive intensity = smoothstep around night; stars opacity at night.

### 5. Camera
- Default: `radius ~28, height ~14, lookAt(0,3,0)`, `angle += 0.05 rad/s`.
- Drag: `pointerdown/move` adjusts `theta/phi` (clamp phi), pauses auto-orbit 4s after release, then resumes. Wheel: zoom clamp 15-45. Works with mouse + touch via Pointer Events.

### 6. Petals + koi motion
- Petals: spawn over tree positions, `y -= fallSpeed`, `x/z += sin(t)*sway`, rotation spin, reset to top when `y<0`.
- Koi: per-fish `t_i = t*speed_i + phase_i`, path: ellipse + sine wobble inside pond bounds to look curved, `mesh.rotation.y = atan2(tangent)`; tail wag scale/rotation.

### 7. Performance / robustness
- Reuse geometries/materials, prefer `InstancedMesh` for repeats; cap pixel ratio at 2; shadow map 2048 only on sun; delta clamp to avoid jumps.
- Handle WebGL fail with overlay message.

### 8. Verification (build phase)
1. Write file, open via `file://` + local server, confirm no console errors.
2. Check: auto-orbit without input, koi swimming curves, petals falling, slider scrubs lighting smoothly, drag orbits and auto-resumes.

**Open question:** Do you want the day-cycle to default to auto-advancing, or start at a fixed golden-hour time with an opt-in cycle? I propose auto-advancing from ~10:00 so users immediately see change.

Final decision: **auto-advancing day cycle, starting at 10:00.**

### Build plan for `index.html`

**1. Single-file setup:**
- One self-contained `index.html`, Three.js via CDN `importmap` pinned to `0.160.0` (unpkg primary + jsdelivr fallback note). No other assets, no build step.
- Custom ~30-line drag-orbit instead of `OrbitControls` import to keep `file://` opening reliable.
- `type="module"` script auto-starts on load: auto-orbit + koi + petals + day-cycle all running, zero input required.

**2. Voxel system:**
- Shared `BoxGeometry(1,1,1)` + material cache by color. Helper `vox(x,y,z,color,sx,sy,sz)`.
- `InstancedMesh` for grass tufts, canopy blobs, petals. Regular meshes for pagoda/trees/lanterns (counts are low).

**3. Garden contents:**
- Base: 32x32 grass island on stepped stone plinth, stone path, fence, rocks/shrubs.
- Pagoda (back-center): 3 tiers, red pillars, cream walls, stepped dark roofs with overhang, spire stack. Windows use emissive material for night glow.
- Cherry trees (x4): brown trunk/branch columns, ~100 jittered pink voxels per canopy in 3 shades.
- Pond (front): recessed basin, transparent animated water plane, stone rim, small bridge/stepping stones.
- Stone lanterns (x4) with warm `PointLight`s, sun + moon spheres, `Points` stars.

**4. Koi (curved paths):**
- 10 voxel koi: 3-body voxels + wagging tail, color variants (white, orange, white/orange, black).
- Each: `pos(t)` = ellipse + sine wobble constrained inside pond, `rotation.y` from tangent. Tail wags with `sin(t*10)`.

**5. Petals:**
- ~300 instanced small pink quads/boxes, spawn above trees, fall + sway + spin, recycle at `y<0`.

**6. Day/night + slider:**
- State `timeOfDay=10.0`, `autoCycle=true`, full day ~90s.
- UI overlay: title, `0-24` slider + readout label + pause/play button. Slider scrubs manually; any manual scrub keeps auto-cycle off until play pressed.
- Per-frame smooth lerp: sun position on arc, sun color/intensity, hemisphere colors, sky/fog color, stars opacity, lantern intensity, window emissive.

**7. Camera:**
- Default slow orbit: `radius 28, height 14, lookAt(0,3,0)`, `0.05 rad/s`.
- Pointer drag to orbit (phi clamped), wheel to zoom (15-45), touch via Pointer Events. Auto-orbit resumes 4s after interaction.

**8. Verify on build:**
- Open via `file://`, check console clean, confirm orbit/koi/petals/cycle/slider/drag all work.

Ready to build on your approval.

Validating CDN importmap compatibility for Threejs modules and outlining voxel terrain construction.
Designing a sunken pond with a rim and pagoda tiers using instanced meshes for canopy voxels.
Adding instanced meshes for canopy and petals plus koi motion and day-night lighting transitions.
Implementing time slider with keyframe color interpolation and camera orbit controls.
Got it — auto day-cycle from morning. Building the self-contained garden now.

- Day/night: 11-keyframe lerp of sky/fog/sun/hemi/lanterns/stars/water; bottom time slider (0-24) + clock readout + Pause/Play.
- Camera: slow auto-orbit, drag to orbit (resumes after 4s), wheel zoom, touch via Pointer Events.
